title: Validate hosted PNG content
responsibility: Check PNG structure and bounded decompressed scanlines before exposing dimensions.

inputs.name: hubPng.bytes
inputs.description: PNG bytes satisfying chunk validation, legal color/depth combinations and positive dimensions; both input and expected decompressed scanlines are capped at 32 MiB.

outputs.name: hubPng
outputs.description: Image width and height after complete deflate data, scanline lengths and filter bytes are checked, including interlaced passes.
